sense.text:
Solomon says, “Behold, I build an house to the name of the Lord my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense”. That house was the temple, and it was built for the worship the Most High commanded: “the continual shewbread”, “the burnt offerings morning and evening”, “on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the Lord our God.”

There is a difference between the sabbath day, the seventh-day sabbath, and the new moon. The new moon is also a sabbath, and it is the beginning of the month.

The solemn feasts are Passover, Tabernacles, the memorial of blowing of trumpets: all these feasts.

“He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.” The moon lets us know the seasons. It lets us know what season we are in: that is how Israel tells time, by the moon.

“From the moon is the sign of feasts”: by the moon you know when the feast days come, because some of the feasts are seasonal.

The moon is “a light that decreaseth in her perfection.” When the moon was created it was a light. When it is new it is a light, and that is its perfection; after it is new, then it decreases. Tonight when you look up in the sky and see that bright light, that is the new moon.

Esau got things all backwards. Esau says the new moon is when it is dark, and our people used to keep it that way at one point in time. But the scripture shows it is when the moon is a light, and that is the way everybody on the earth is going to keep the new moon when Christ returns, whether they believe it now or not.

“The month is called after her name”: the word month comes from the moon. And after the moon decreases it increases again, “increasing wonderfully in her changing, being an instrument of the armies above, shining in the firmament of heaven”.

“The vision of all” is all the visions God gave the prophets, and all of them are written in a book. That book “that is sealed” is the Bible.

Men deliver it “to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee”: read this Bible, I pray thee. “And he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed”. The Bible is sealed, and not everyone can understand it. The visions of Daniel, the visions of John the Revelator, the visions of Jeremiah: nobody on earth can understand this book, because it is sealed.

So don't let anybody question whether you are a prophet. There are thousands of prophets in IUIC, not just one. When you say you are a prophet, say it plainly: I am a prophet of God.

And a prophet of God must watch geopolitics: the wars and the policies being passed all over the world. The Lord told us to watch and pray, and we watch because the things taking place on the earth are the Lord doing it.

precepts.why:
This is how you prove that we are prophets. “Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid?” The trumpet is evil coming. “Shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?” The evil that happens in a city is the judgment of God: plagues, destruction. When these things happen, it is the Lord that does it.

“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” So the book that is sealed, who does God reveal it to? Who will understand the Bible? The prophets.

That is what makes a man a prophet: the book that is sealed, he is able to read it and understand it. If you can understand the visions, you are a prophet. If you can understand the Bible, you are a prophet.

Once you can understand the Bible, that makes you a prophet. But how are you able to understand it? “Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.” “But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit”.

Unto us: at that time it was the apostles and the believers in Christ. God revealed to our forefathers back then the visions of Jeremiah, of Isaiah, of Daniel, the same way they are revealed to us today. And it is by his Spirit: the Spirit of God that dwells in us. That is what makes us prophets, and that is how we are able to understand the Bible.

“For the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.” Those deep things, those parables, those dark sentences: the Spirit searches them out and shows them to us. “Even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.” The Spirit of God understands the things of God and reveals them to us: what God plans for the future, what is going to happen on this earth in these last days.

The prophets wrote what is going to happen, and the things you see taking place on this earth are written there. It is sealed, and only the prophets can understand it. Only the sons of God, the Israelites, can understand these visions, because we have the Spirit of God dwelling in us.

sense.text:
This is Pax Americana in the scripture. One of the seven angels says, “Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great” harlot, and that great harlot is America.

She “sitteth upon many waters”: she rules many nations.

All “the kings of the earth have committed fornication” with America, “and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.” That wine of fornication is falsehood, lies and oppression.

“I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast”. That woman, that hoe sitting upon the scarlet coloured beast, is America. The scarlet coloured beast is Europe: the European Union and NATO.

“Full of names of blasphemy”: they call themselves Jews, they call themselves Christians, they call themselves the people of God. They are liars and thieves. It is blasphemy to say you are a Jew when you are not a Jew.

“Having seven heads and ten horns”: the same seven heads and ten horns that are in Daniel.

“Arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls”: this country is rich. And she has “a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication”: every kind of abomination.

Her name is “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT”. This is not ancient Babylon. It is called mystery because many do not understand that this place is the abomination of the earth. This place is spiritual Babylon.

She is “THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS”, the mother of hoes, “AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH”. America is the abomination of this earth: that is what God says.

John “saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus”, and he wondered. The angel asks, “Wherefore didst thou marvel?” Why are you marvelling? “I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her”: who that harlot is, and who the ten horns and seven heads carrying her are. The Lord is about to let John know what he is seeing.

“The beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth”: the eighth is that harlot, mystery Babylon. “And is of the seven”: it came from the seven, and the seven is Britain. America came from Britain and fought Britain for its independence.

“And goeth into perdition”: that eighth goes into destruction. America will be destroyed.

“The ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings”: the European Union. Today it is many more nations, but in the beginning it was ten. They “have received no kingdom as yet”, because Europe and the European Union were not set up yet.

They “receive power as kings one hour with the beast”: for a time, together with America. That time began in 1945, after World War II.

“These have one mind”: all Europe has one mind. They “shall give their power and strength unto the beast”: they gave their military strength and their economic strength to America. They formed the NATO alliance, the United Nations, the International Monetary Fund. All these institutions that rule the earth today came about in 1945, Europe and America together, and that is when the American peace began.

They said we need to set up peace on the earth. But all these institutions were set up to oppress the poor, and for America and Europe to keep control over the world.

“These shall make war with the Lamb”. Christ is the Lamb. When Christ returns, Europe and America will fight against him, “and the Lamb shall overcome them”: Christ is going to destroy America and Europe, “for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings”.

“And they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful”: that is the 144.

We are prophets, and everything we bring out of these scriptures is going to come to pass. That is how you will tell whether we are prophets or not: watch the things that are going to happen on this earth.

“The waters which thou sawest” “are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” This proves that America and Europe rule over all nations. When Europe gave its power to America after World War II, that was the beginning of Pax Americana.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate” her. This is what you see taking place today. Europe gave its power to America for a time, over 70 years, and that time is up. Trump came into office and started disrespecting Europe; there was free trade between Europe and America, and now he says, you have been using us for 70 years, you have to start paying tariffs. Trump wants to leave NATO. The economics, the military, everything is changing, and Europe is seeing that it cannot depend on America.

So right now there is a rift between the hoe and the ten horns, and that is all by design. America is going to do things to make NATO and the European Union hate it. We have been saying for years that Europe will turn against America, and now it is happening before our eyes. If you can see that, you are a prophet.

They “shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” America will be destroyed with nuclear bombs, and NATO, along with Russia, Iran and the rest, is going to play a big role in destroying Babylon.

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will”. God put it in the Europeans’ heart, in NATO’s heart. When they formed the NATO alliance and the European Union, everything they were doing was prophecy: they were fulfilling God’s will.

“And to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast”: for those 70 years they agreed with America and gave America their strength. That was for a time, “until the words of God shall be fulfilled.”

That is what you see now, the words of God being fulfilled. That is why you see the separation and the division taking place: the word that has to be fulfilled is that they are going to hate the harlot and burn her with fire.

precepts.why:
What is the judgment for a hoe according to the law? “And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself” by playing the harlot, “she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.” That was the judgment for a hoe: she has to be burned with fire. This is for you sisters out there that like to hoe around.

So the great hoe of Revelation 17 has to be burned with fire. That is why the ten horns “burn her with fire.” And what kind of fire? Thermonuclear destruction.

sense.text:
What you are seeing is Europe turning against America. Europe is building up its own military so it can depend on America less and less, and America is bullying Europe and all the nations.

“Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”. “An ambassador is sent among the heathen”: that ambassador is the one the Arabs call the Mahdi; somebody is going to rise up amongst Ishmael and say, “Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.”

They are going to rise up in battle against America and Israel. This prophecy concerns America and Israel together. A bill has been passed where the military of America and the military of Israel are becoming one. They look like two different countries, but they are one.

“Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen”: look at the land of Israel, small, with the Arabs surrounding it.

“Thou art greatly despised.” America and Israel are greatly despised: by the Arabs, by the European nations, by Russia, by China. All the nations are going to hate America and Israel because of what is taking place in Palestine, in Lebanon and in Iran.

What America and Israel are doing in Iran is going to cause a global collapse: not a recession, a world depression. A loss of jobs, things getting crazy, and famine.

“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”. See how Trump speaks: very prideful, saying he destroyed their military within two days. He started the war but cannot come out of it. That is the pride the white man has, that America and Israel have: we have the technology, nobody can fight against us. It has deceived them. They think they are untouchable, but God has them thinking that way for a reason.

“Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock”: that is where the term Caucasians comes from. “Whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” This is what they say: we have the strongest military in the world, nobody can take us down. That is the pride.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: this tells you it is talking about America. What is America’s symbol? The eagle. “And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: America was the first to travel to space, in 1969.

“Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.” From 1945 to the 70s America was at its peak, and the 70s were the end of America. In 1969 the Israelites started waking up and the teachings of God started going out. That is how he brings them down, and that is where all of us here came from.

“All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border”: this is Europe turning against America, everybody America made a confederacy with, the European Union and the NATO alliance. The border is down there in Israel.

“The men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee”: that is NATO. They will deceive America, “and prevailed against thee”, and they will burn her with fire. “They that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.” They don’t care; they will destroy this place. That is the Bible prophecy.

What America did is shown here. “And in the latter time of their kingdom”: the last days, the time we are living in right now. “When the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.”

Understanding dark sentences: they can understand the Bible to a certain extent, and what they don’t understand they are online right now learning from us.

In the history this king of fierce countenance is Antiochus. But this scripture is twofold: it is Antiochus, and it is America. The same thing that was done back then is going to be done again in these last days.

“And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”. That king is a system: it is America. Not because the white man is so strong or so smart. His power is his technology, the nuclear bombs and all the weapons he used to conquer the world, and Satan gave him that power.

“And he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise”. All through history the white man did much genocidal evil, and all the evil he does, he prospers in it and keeps practising it. See how he is destroying wonderfully, bombing all over the place.

“And shall destroy the mighty and the holy people”: the twelve tribes of Israel. Antiochus did that in the past, and the same thing Antiochus did, America did, and America is going to do it again.

“And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”. His policy is his politics, his economics and his religion. Craft here means deceit, cunning, trickery and clever scheming. The same way Antiochus prospered by it, America prospered by it.

The craft is the deceit and the lies set up since 1945: the IMF telling countries how much their money is worth, robbing Africa of its resources, tariffs on the nations, sending the CIA into countries to assassinate leaders. And Christianity: didn’t it prosper in his hand? The whole world following the white man and worshipping a white Jesus, deceived into thinking God is white. Financial or religious, all of it prospered in his hand.

“And he shall magnify himself in his heart”: the same way Antiochus set himself up as God. A new Christianity is coming with the white Christian nationalists.

“And by peace shall destroy many.” This is the point. Pax Americana is Latin for American peace, and that American peace is the peace of Daniel 8:25. The same way Antiochus said, let us all be one people, America came after World War II, after the white man killed 80 million people, and said, let us have peace now. It set up peace through military strength, through economic strength, and through forcing its values on everyone: that is democracy. Set up your government the way we set up ours, give rights to women and homosexuals. And it killed a great many people establishing Pax Americana: countries destroyed, leaders destroyed, governments overthrown by the CIA and by war, Iraq, Afghanistan, North Korea, where people are still born with deformities from the chemicals dropped on them. Millions have died from 1945 until now for America and Europe to keep that hegemony.

There will be another form of peace they try to set up: the Abrahamic Accords, the one religion and the one world order. And they are going to kill those of us who do not follow it, the same way.

“He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”. Antiochus did not fight against Christ, so this shows it is twofold: America and Europe will stand up against Christ. “But he shall be broken without hand”: the same as the image in Daniel whose feet were broken by a stone without hands.

precepts.why:
Who is the Prince he stands up against? “The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.” The Romans killed him. “Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel”.

Christ is that Prince. Antiochus never fought against Christ, so Daniel 8 is speaking of the last days too. It is the same thing read in Revelation 17, that they will make war with the Lamb and the Lamb will overcome them, just as here he “shall be broken without hand.”

How did America get the power it has? John “saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns”, the same seven heads and ten horns read in Revelation 17. “And upon his heads the name of blasphemy”: this is the white man, the European Union, the fourth beast, “like unto a leopard.”

“And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death”: that was Rome, which fell in 193 AD. “And his deadly wound was healed”: Rome came back as America in 1776. “And all the world wondered after the beast”: all the world wonders after the white man.

“And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast”. Who is the dragon that gave the beast power? Satan. So when you worship the white man’s God, you are worshipping Satan. Don’t think the white man got all this power because he is so smart. He was able to come up with all these technologies and advances because Satan gave him that power. That is why Daniel says, “not by his own power.”

This is the ten horns, and it is America. “He shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws”.

To wear out the saints is the same thing Daniel 8 says: he “shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” The same way Antiochus destroyed us, America wore us out. America enslaved us, destroyed the North American Indians, and destroyed us over here on this side of the world.

And it is not only what they did to us but what they are going to do to us. The same way Antiochus killed us when we would not follow his policies, the same thing is going to happen in the future. This is future prophecy.

“And the dragon was wroth with the woman”: the woman is Israel, and the dragon was angry with us. He “went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God”.

This war is physical, and the dragon is the white man. As we keep teaching this word and Israel wakes up all over the world, America, Israel and Europe will make war with us. The teaching of Christ is a revolution, and we are labelled a threat to this whole system. Right now there are FBI agents in some of our schools, watching us and planning how to destroy this movement. So don’t sleep: watch and pray. As leaders, you have to be willing to die for what you believe in.

When they make war with us, what happens? “I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus”. America, that great harlot, is going to be drunk with the blood of the saints.

Why would America be drunk with the blood of the saints and the martyrs? That is the war that is coming for teaching the word of God. Many of us are going to be killed here in America. The same thing Antiochus did back then, America will do. Every leader in the past who rose up and spoke against America, its values and its democracy was killed, assassinated or put in prison.

They cry, “Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.”

“Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.” Why would the apostles and prophets rejoice when mystery Babylon, America, is destroyed? Because God has to avenge them on her: in that war many of the prophets will die here in Babylon teaching the word of God. The prophets are here, and that is why there are thousands of prophets in IUIC. And the apostles are here too.

To understand “by peace shall destroy many” we have to go to the history. “King Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people”. All should be one people: today that is called democracy. “And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.” All the heathen left their laws and customs and followed what Antiochus set up.

Democracy is being subservient, with somebody at the head. Antiochus was the head and all the nations served him. Democracy is a form of slavery. After 1945 America went all over the world pushing democracy, saying let us all be one: India, the Caribbean islands, South America, Africa all follow it. It came after colonialism, when America and Europe said we are going to push our values on the whole world. Democracy is white people’s values, it is Christianity, it is taking your resources and giving you nothing for it. It is white people ruling and everybody else serving them. Everybody wears the suit and tie, everybody has a senate and a constitution, and they got all of that from Esau.

“Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.” Democracy and religion go hand in hand; that is how they push their religion all over the world. The king sent letters “that they should follow the strange laws of the land”, forbidding burnt offerings and sacrifice, that “they should profane the sabbaths and festival days”, “and pollute the sanctuary and holy people”.

“And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.” If you did not follow, you were killed. Let us all be one people, let us set up peace, follow my traditions and my customs, and if you don’t, you die. That is what “by peace shall destroy many” means, and America did the same thing: since 1945 it has killed and assassinated millions to keep its hegemony, Pax Americana, over the world.

“And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.”

The two horns like a lamb are their two political parties, the Democrats and the Republicans. Like a lamb, because they say they are a Christian, God-fearing society, about justice, rights and peace: we are going to help you, we are spreading love and peace on the earth. That is their democracy, their craft, their deceit, what Daniel 8 calls the craft that prospers in his hand.

But “he spake as a dragon”: if you do not follow the two horns, if you do not follow their democracy and agree with their policies and their politics, they will kill you. That is why it says by peace he shall destroy many.

In the CIA they did not care about democracy; the true goal is control. Every government in South America overthrown by the CIA since 1947, from Guatemala and Brazil to Chile and Venezuela, was against the order America set up. Maurice Bishop in Grenada brought free health care and literacy with help from Cuba, and they killed him because black people doing good, and a black nation that could speak to 30 million black people in America, was a danger to them; then America invaded Grenada. Patrice Lumumba, Thomas Sankara, Che Guevara and many more were killed for not following democracy. Democracy is not about freedom and justice: it is about falling in line and serving America and Europe, and through that peace they destroyed many.
